name: Halcyon Payroll Cloud
description: Payroll software provider for small businesses in the fictional region of Brightwater.

items.title: Published outage report
items.content: Halcyon's public post-incident report HPC-PIR-0914 says a failed database migration on 2026-09-14 delayed pay runs for 2,960 employers by up to 19 hours.

items.title: Support hours
items.content: Phone support runs 08:05 to 18:25 on weekdays; payday support extends to 21:00 on the last Friday of the month. Page HPC-SUP-1.

items.title: Tax table update process
items.content: Tax tables are loaded by the compliance team by 23:45 the night before they take effect and checked against 26 test payslips. Process HPC-TAX-26.

items.title: Customer success targets
items.content: Each customer success manager handles 145 accounts and must hold net retention above 104.5%. Targets HPC-CS-145.

items.title: Penetration test findings
items.content: Tester Ironclad Labs found 3 critical issues, including a way to change bank details without re-authentication; the fix deadline is 2026-12-04. Report HPC-PT-1204-I.

items.title: Acquisition offer
items.content: Larkwell Software has offered $48M for Halcyon; the board meets on 2026-11-18 and founders would stay for 2 years. Letter HPC-MA-1118-L.
